description_sq:
Ne nje prej zonave elitare te kryeqytetit shitet apartament luksoz 3+1+2.
Apartamenti ka vendndodhje favorizuese tek Rruga e Elbasanit prane Ambasades Amerikane.
Vendodhja strategjike i mundeson akses te menjehershem me rruget kryesore dhe parkun e liqenit.
Ky apartament vjen totalisht i investuar me detaje luksoze si ne rifinitura si duke filluar tek Mermeri Taj Mahal rek kurridori dhe ambjenti i dites dhe dhpomat e gjumit me parket druri si dhe tualetet te veshura me gure Onyx.
Ne apartament ndodhet Bufeja e kuzhines si dhe dhomat e gjumit te paisura me dollape.
Ofron organizim ideal te gjithe hapesirave te apartamentit, duke bere shfrytezim dhe ndarje te rregullt midis ambientit te dites dhe dhomave te gjumit.
Organizohet me korridor hyres,.
Korridori ben shperndarjen dhe ne 3 dhomave te gjumit. (matrimonialja ka tualet personal) dhe tualet qendror.
Apartamenti disponion dhe nje post parkimi ne cmim.
Ky apartamenti disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor.
title_en: 3+1+2 luxury apartment near the American Embassy.
description_en: In one of the elite areas of the capital, a luxury apartment 3+1+2 is for sale. The apartment has a favorable location on Rruga e Elbasani near the American Embassy. The strategic location allows immediate access to major roads and the lake park. This apartment comes fully invested with luxurious details, such as refinishing, starting with Taj Mahal marble, the hallway and the living room, and the bedrooms with wooden parquet, as well as the bathrooms covered with Onyx stones. In the apartment there is a kitchen buffet as well as bedrooms equipped with wardrobes. It offers ideal organization of all the spaces of the apartment, making proper use and separation between the living room and bedrooms. It is organized with an entrance corridor. The corridor also divides the 3 bedrooms. (the matrimonial house has a private toilet) and a central toilet. The apartment also has a parking space in the price. This apartment has regular mortgage documentation.
